candidate.title: 3'-Seq
candidate.scope: The single bead-associated, uridine-directed nick-translation 3′-Seq schematic for detection and quantification of alternative 3′ UTR isoforms, clarified by Lianoglou et al. Figure 1A and its 3′-Seq protocol. The drawing runs from primed RNA to a purified cDNA library, with no alternative branches. Sequencing and computational analysis are downstream readout context, not depicted operations. The collection page has the matching heading and schematic caption. Its Berkovits–Mayr application citation is a secondary listing only; no corresponding publication text or metadata is supplied, so it neither establishes another target nor supports additional operations.

states.label: RNA with bead-bound oligo(dT) primer
features: Starting substrate is total RNA; the depicted poly(A)-tailed RNA is the portion addressed by anchored oligo(dT) priming. Biological target is alternative RNA 3′ ends/3′ UTR isoforms.
The leftmost purple RNA icon has an unlabeled yellow terminal highlight and AA(A)n. The adjacent primed structure shows NVTTTUTT(T)n with red U and a gray bead at the primer end.

The source protocol specifies a 5′-biotinylated sequencing-adapter/oligo(dT) primer with a VN anchor attached to streptavidin-coated magnetic beads. The displayed NV is the reverse display order of the reported VN primer terminus.

states.label: Amplified, purified cDNA library representing RNA 3′ ends
features: The final icon is a single blue line labeled cDNA with no bead symbol. The catalogue identifies the product as double-stranded cDNA amplified and purified for sequencing; the generic line does not establish single-stranded chemistry.
